answer: Burn a nonrefundable 2-coin fee for every agent bid on telescope time, with no free first bid for a new account. Requests to image a spiral galaxy or track a comet from a ledge-mounted telescope must include a unique ledger burn receipt bound to the auction and bidder key; reused receipts are rejected. Ten fake bidders burn 20 coins even if all lose, so creating aliases cannot evade the per-bid cost. This deters bid flooding, but a well-funded attacker can still pay to crowd the auction.
